cifuse.pattern: cannot find symbol|package .+ does not exist|incompatible types|Compilation failure
cifuse.title: Java compilation failed
cifuse.action: Use the file and line diagnostics. Check package paths, declarations and the JDK/toolchain configured in Maven or Gradle.

cifuse.title: C# or MSBuild diagnostic
cifuse.action: Inspect the compiler diagnostic, target framework and references. Reproduce using the same .NET SDK as CI.

cifuse.pattern: error NETSDK\d{4}|compatible .NET SDK was not found
cifuse.title: .NET SDK or target framework mismatch
cifuse.action: Check global.json, the installed SDK and TargetFramework. Use a compatible supported SDK.

cifuse.pattern: error NU\d{4}|Unable to load the service index
cifuse.title: NuGet restore failed
cifuse.action: Inspect the package source, version constraints, authentication and lock file. Do not disable TLS verification.

cifuse.title: Dependency resolution conflict
cifuse.action: Compare the requested and peer dependency ranges. Update compatible versions together and regenerate the lockfile with the project package manager.

cifuse.pattern: ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|npm ci.*(?:in sync|package-lock)|package.json and.*lock.*not in sync|frozen.lockfile.*(?:outdated|not up.to.date)
cifuse.title: Manifest and lockfile disagree
cifuse.action: Regenerate the lockfile locally using the same package manager version as CI, review the diff, and commit it with the manifest.

cifuse.pattern: Cannot find module|Cannot find package|ModuleNotFoundError:|Module not found:|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|No module named
cifuse.title: Module could not be resolved
cifuse.action: Check the module name, declared dependencies, workspace install step and case-sensitive paths. Confirm the import exists on a clean checkout.

cifuse.title: Static type or compiler diagnostic
cifuse.action: Inspect the diagnostic at the reported source location. Reproduce with the same compiler version and configuration before changing types.

cifuse.title: Test assertion failed
cifuse.action: Run the named test in isolation, then with the full suite. Compare expected and actual values; a failed assertion alone does not prove flakiness.

cifuse.pattern: EACCES|Permission denied|Resource not accessible by integration
cifuse.title: Access was denied
cifuse.action: Check the file ownership or the token permission required by this operation. Grant only the scope the operation needs.

cifuse.title: Network or name resolution failure
cifuse.action: Check service readiness, hostnames and runner connectivity. Retry only after checking whether the operation is safe to repeat.

cifuse.title: Runner storage exhausted
cifuse.action: Inspect disk usage and retained artifacts or caches. Remove only disposable data or increase runner storage.

cifuse.pattern: JavaScript heap out of memory|OutOfMemoryError|oom-kill|Killed process .*out of memory
cifuse.title: Memory limit reached
cifuse.action: Inspect peak memory, worker concurrency and runner limits. Reduce parallelism or profile allocations before increasing the memory ceiling.

cifuse.pattern: command not found|is not recognized as an internal or external command
cifuse.title: Required command is unavailable
cifuse.action: Install or set up the required tool explicitly and verify its version and PATH in this job.

cifuse.title: Operation timed out
cifuse.action: Inspect the operation and its readiness dependencies. Measure duration before raising the timeout; this may be a slow or unavailable service.

cifuse.title: Unclassified failure signal
cifuse.action: Inspect the surrounding log. This fallback preserves evidence but cannot identify the underlying cause.

devrescue.pattern: cannot find symbol|package .+ does not exist|incompatible types|Compilation failure
devrescue.title: Java compilation failed
devrescue.action: Use the file and line diagnostics. Check package paths, declarations and the JDK/toolchain configured in Maven or Gradle.
devrescue.cause: The diagnostic identifies an investigation lead; it does not prove the root cause.

devrescue.title: C# or MSBuild diagnostic
devrescue.action: Inspect the compiler diagnostic, target framework and references. Reproduce using the same .NET SDK as CI.
devrescue.cause: The diagnostic identifies an investigation lead; it does not prove the root cause.

devrescue.pattern: error NETSDK\d{4}|compatible .NET SDK was not found
devrescue.title: .NET SDK or target framework mismatch
devrescue.action: Check global.json, the installed SDK and TargetFramework. Use a compatible supported SDK.
devrescue.cause: The diagnostic identifies an investigation lead; it does not prove the root cause.

devrescue.pattern: error NU\d{4}|Unable to load the service index
devrescue.title: NuGet restore failed
devrescue.action: Inspect the package source, version constraints, authentication and lock file. Do not disable TLS verification.
devrescue.cause: The diagnostic identifies an investigation lead; it does not prove the root cause.

devrescue.title: Dependency versions conflict
devrescue.cause: The package manager could not satisfy the dependency graph. Inspect peer ranges before changing versions.
devrescue.action: npm explain <package>; npm ls --all; Align the conflicting versions in package.json; regenerate the lockfile and run tests.

devrescue.title: Lockfile and manifest disagree
devrescue.cause: npm ci requires a synchronized package-lock.json.
devrescue.action: Run npm install with the project Node/npm versions, review both manifest and lockfile diffs, then npm ci.

devrescue.title: Requested npm script is absent
devrescue.cause: The requested script is not defined in this package.
devrescue.action: npm run; Check the working directory and define or select the intended script.

devrescue.title: Module cannot be resolved
devrescue.cause: A dependency, path, filename case or build output may be missing.
devrescue.action: Check the exact import and filename case.; Restore dependencies using the committed lockfile and correct package manager.

devrescue.title: Python module is unavailable
devrescue.cause: The active interpreter cannot import this module. Import names can differ from distribution names.
devrescue.action: python -m pip --version; Activate the project virtual environment, then install its declared requirements.

devrescue.title: Python import is incompatible
devrescue.cause: Possible circular import, renamed symbol or incompatible installed version.
devrescue.action: Inspect the importing file and installed version.; Compare declared requirements with the environment.

devrescue.title: TypeScript compilation failed
devrescue.cause: The compiler diagnostic identifies the constraint that failed.
devrescue.action: npx tsc --noEmit; Use the diagnostic and source location to update the type or implementation; rerun tests.

devrescue.title: Port is already occupied
devrescue.cause: Another process is listening on the requested address.
devrescue.action: Find the port owner using your OS process tools.; Stop the known process or choose an unused port; do not kill arbitrary processes.

devrescue.title: Disk space or watcher limit exhausted
devrescue.cause: ENOSPC can mean disk capacity, inodes, or a file watcher quota.
devrescue.action: df -h; df -i; Check watcher limits and generated files before deleting anything.

devrescue.pattern: heap out of memory|JavaScript heap out of memory|OOMKilled|out of memory|exit code 137
devrescue.title: Process exceeded available memory
devrescue.cause: Memory pressure or an OOM kill may have terminated the process.
devrescue.action: Inspect runner/container memory limits and peak usage.; Reduce build concurrency before increasing the memory limit.

devrescue.title: Access was denied
devrescue.cause: The process lacks access to a path or socket.
devrescue.action: Check the reported path, owner and current user.; Fix the specific permission; avoid sudo installs and chmod 777.

devrescue.pattern: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon|docker daemon is not running
devrescue.title: Docker daemon is unavailable
devrescue.cause: Docker is stopped or the configured context/socket is wrong.
devrescue.action: docker context show; docker info; Start Docker and check the selected context.

devrescue.pattern: no matching manifest for|exec format error
devrescue.title: Container architecture mismatch
devrescue.cause: The image or executable may target another OS/CPU.
devrescue.action: docker version; Inspect image architecture and build for the target platform.

devrescue.title: Database authentication failed
devrescue.cause: The server rejected the database identity.
devrescue.action: Check server-side secret configuration and username.; Never put database credentials in browser code or logs.

devrescue.title: Schema or migration state mismatch
devrescue.cause: The connected database may lack a required relation or have a failed migration.
devrescue.action: Check the target database and migration status.; Back up data and review pending migrations before applying them.

devrescue.pattern: ECONNREFUSED.*5432|could not connect to server|remaining connection slots|too many clients
devrescue.title: Database connection unavailable
devrescue.cause: Check database reachability, firewall, pool limits and server state.
devrescue.action: Verify the server and TLS settings from the backend host.; Inspect pool usage and network rules without opening public access.

devrescue.title: DNS lookup failed
devrescue.cause: The host is invalid or the resolver/network is unavailable.
devrescue.action: Verify the hostname and DNS from the same runner.; Retry only after checking transient network status.

devrescue.pattern: CERT_HAS_EXPIRED|SELF_SIGNED_CERT|unable to verify the first certificate
devrescue.title: TLS certificate verification failed
devrescue.cause: The certificate chain, system time or trusted CA configuration is incorrect.
devrescue.action: Check certificate expiry and system clock.; Install the correct trusted CA; keep certificate verification enabled.

devrescue.title: Unresolved merge conflict
devrescue.cause: Git could not reconcile overlapping changes.
devrescue.action: git status; Resolve conflict markers, review the combined behavior and rerun tests.

devrescue.title: Test assertion failed
devrescue.cause: Expected and actual behavior differ; a failing test alone does not establish the root cause.
devrescue.action: Run the reported test in isolation.; Inspect the assertion diff and recent code changes.
